# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    t AS (
        SELECT
            LOWER(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name,
            DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS sale_date
        FROM Sales
    )
SELECT product_name, sale_date, COUNT(1) AS total
FROM t
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
